name: cipherchat-messenger
description: Self-hostable secure team messaging: exactly-once delivery, E2EE DMs (messages + attachments), Redis-backed horizontal scaling, content-free observability — with the tests and live demos to prove all four.
author: Simran Yadav

scripts.install-all: cd chat-back && npm install && cd ../chat-front && npm install
scripts.test: cd chat-back && npm test && cd ../chat-front && npm test
scripts.typecheck: cd chat-back && npm run typecheck && cd ../chat-front && npm run typecheck
